findings: All six ordinals and all 78 frame samples passed original and independent checks. Sources, complete tracked fresh file hashes, tool, installed dependency versions, viewport, camera trajectory, initial world/actor positions, Chromium version and SwiftShader GL identity agree as intended. Every owned browser/preview close and worktree cleanup is recorded successful before next ordinal.

Current warm total-wall run medians are lower than both 906 run medians. The forward matched difference is -4.56%, reverse corresponding difference is -2.83%; the mean of two run medians is 1007.525 ms versus 1046.25 ms, -3.70%. This is a finite same-host observation, not proof of pure runtime improvement under every load.

The observed median reduction is concentrated in synchronous readback wall time; mean-of-run CPU render medians are 24.9 ms current versus 25.125 ms 906. Per-metric medians do not add exactly to the median of totals.

Cold total wall current is 3629.6 / 3635.0 ms versus 906 3615.7 / 3675.0 ms. Their ranges overlap; cold improvement is not established. Cold frame excludes construction and asset wait, which are separately preserved.

Within-source later-minus-earlier warm median drift is +0.54% acf, -1.21% 906 and +0.58% current. First acf warm frame12 reaches 1078.7 ms (readback 1064.7 ms) and is retained rather than discarded. All warm samples are preserved.

All same-source pairs have byte-identical original PNGs and byte-identical inspection-build output fingerprints. Current versus 906 reported renderer triangle count is 408948 versus 448448 (-39500, -8.81%) while calls374, geometries379, textures35 and scanned leaf-containing batch triangles375296 agree. These are renderer.info observations, not total GPU workload or proof of the precise culling cause.

All six original images were viewed. Current shows more leaf faces and changed foliage shadows compared with 906; broad bare ground and sparse scene remain. No blank scene was observed. Wide frames cannot certify the ridge-ground seam or PS4 visual quality.
limitations: Single GitHub Linux host with two independent browser runs per source, fixed symmetric order, no randomized repetitions and no external-host load control; hostLoadAverageAtStart changes and is retained. Same-job provenance and close records support host/process isolation; per-process PID inventory is not recorded.
Chromium 141.0.7390.37 using ANGLE SwiftShader on a virtualized Xeon host. Not physical-device performance, not a pure GPU timer, not actual game FPS.

cpuRenderMs includes JS and any driver/compiler blocking inside view.render; synchronous readbackWallMs includes pending drawing, synchronization/IPC and 2764800-byte RGBA transfer. totalWallMs is their sum, excluding reset, GL status queries and pixel analysis (warm median about31 ms) and Node round-trip overhead.

Four ReadPixels GPU-stall performance warnings occur per ordinal and all24 remain in originals and this result. No observed GL error, context loss, page/console error or failed request; this does not prove absence of unreported driver faults.

finalPage.restored=false is a snapshot captured before the subsequent explicit restore call; final report.restoration.restored=true and cleanup true are checked. It is not an observed restoration failure.

No variants, video, combat simulation, input, sound or mobile performance measured here. Authored world time is frame/60 with dt1/60 and no simulation advance. Old e188 or finish-based different-host measurements are excluded from quantitative comparisons.
PNG identity only proves repeatability of this specific view/time. It does not establish ten-element quality acceptance, PS4 target attainment, or root-contact correctness.
The actual 906-to-4fa runtime diff includes both bamboo crown and maple leaf fixed inclinations. Measurements isolate this complete candidate, not a bamboo-only edit or any single mechanism.

candidateDiffScope.runtimeChange: Fixed bamboo crown roll and maple lamina inclination changes in fresh/presentation.js; bamboo-frond.js has explanatory comment changes. Remaining fresh diff files are tests. This is not a bamboo-only causal isolation. Tool and lockfile have no diff.
candidateDiffScope.drawCountInterpretation: Geometry scan agrees, while renderer-reported drawn triangles differ. No independent per-pass culling breakdown was captured; the cause of the draw-count change is not claimed.
